## Capability-market objective
Implement and validate `translation_delivery` as a reusable `bounded_translation` delivery capability for 1 currently observed cash-first opportunity(ies).

- Market score: 46.19
- Cluster: `cluster-32b15a1bdeecbda4`
- Current opportunities unlocked: 1
- Independent sources: 1
- First-payment probability signal: 0.2833
- Evidence: https://www.freelancer.com/projects/translation/cultural-anthropology-research-assistant

## Acceptance tests
- [ ] reject missing or unverified payer and scope evidence
- [ ] reject work that prohibits AI, automation or the authorized delivery method
- [ ] produce a deterministic or bounded artifact from a fixture
- [ ] validate completeness, schema, formatting and source traceability
- [ ] record artifact hashes, test command, result and elapsed effort
- [ ] fail closed at account, terms, identity, contract and payout gates
- [ ] re-run market qualification immediately after promotion

## Promotion, stop and budget rules
- Promote only after green unit tests, one reproducible dry-run artifact and no regression in the versioned business benchmark.
- Defer if the cluster has no qualifying mission for three consecutive cycles, score falls below 35, or a mandatory human/physical constraint dominates.
- Use existing local and cloud infrastructure first; any paid dependency or external purchase requires explicit approval.

Simulation values are planning signals only and are not revenue, pipeline or submissions.
